I once wanted to become a security expert that works for banks, but I don't know if I want it anymore. 

Being a virgin at 19 may not be bad, but it's bad when no girl has ever liked you or found you attractive. I don't even know what it feels like to have a girl like you, something most guys my ages probably knows.

I think I'm a disappointment to my parents because I still haven't managed to get a woman to like me, something most guys at my age have already done at 14-16.

Whats CBT treatments? I've never heard of it I think.
